title: Degree-zero ring sheaf is a unit for the recorded derived tensor
statement: For a small site J, commutative ring sheaf R and R-module sheaf M [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], the recorded derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] of R[0] with M[0], in either order, is isomorphic to M[0]. No flatness of M is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06YQ (bounded flat K-flat), 06YP (K-flat quasi-isomorphism) and 06YU (derived Tor)

proof.text: Tensor with the unit is the identity via the ordinary right unitor, hence the unit is flat. Its single complex is K-flat because tensoring any acyclic complex with it is isomorphic to that complex.
Take a flat-term K-flat resolution of M[0]. The recorded total tensor comparison identifies the derived tensor with its total tensor with the unit single complex.
The explicit HomologicalComplex left and right unitors identify both total complexes with the chosen resolution. Localize and compose with the augmentation isomorphism.
